clauses.title: Dados e seleção comuns
clauses.proposal: Planck3+DESI13+V01local267; mesmos dados nos cinco modelos; V01 não é V1.
clauses.application_condition: Identidade e ordem pinadas; centros e composto não abertos; fatoração/compressão são INPUT explícito.
clauses.implementation_gap: Resolver MM e qualificar o modelo de dados conjunto antes do V1.

clauses.title: Cinco mapas de média
clauses.proposal: H1/H2/H3/H4/H5 do V2; beta só R-A local; H4 por c_C delta_C; H5 rd BAO livre/rstar padrão.
clauses.application_condition: Suporte/resposta comum; H3 contém H1/H2; validade da correspondência R-A por indicador.
clauses.implementation_gap: Integrar os mapas ao motor comum sem duplicar beta ou comprimir H4 como deslocamento agregado.

clauses.title: Priors físicos
clauses.proposal: Priores físicos normalizados do V2, com jacobianos s->delta_C e rd->q.
clauses.application_condition: Domínio inteiro e medida explícita; beta_TGL não ajustado; sem prior uniforme novo em q/delta.
clauses.implementation_gap: Ratificar os limites existentes e a implementação do transporte.

clauses.title: Nuisance comum relativo
clauses.proposal: kappa d eta comum em R63; razões relativas finitas/não nulas, não evidência absoluta.
clauses.application_condition: rank suportado63, suporte afim comum, X/C comuns; determinantes/jacobianos mantidos.
clauses.implementation_gap: Verificar condições no modelo conjunto; não inventar larguras de prior próprio.

clauses.title: Covariância e sensibilidades
clauses.proposal: 300 rótulos estelares interiores x 2 receitas SBF condicionais; todos reportados.
clauses.application_condition: 600 rótulos potenciais; família restrita e cobertura limitada; sem seleção por resultado.
clauses.implementation_gap: Qualificar C conjunta por cenário; deduplicar apenas com certificado e mapa de rótulos.

clauses.title: Modelo dos masers
clauses.proposal: Variâncias dos cinco MM permanecem simbólicas; modelo condicional versus propagação primitiva explicitados.
clauses.application_condition: Covariância plug-in/data-dependent não herda validade finita exata; condicional publicado tem alcance restrito.
clauses.implementation_gap: Definir experimento e propagação relativa numa unidade permitida, sem apagar MM ou trocar seleção.

clauses.title: Fundo CAMB
clauses.proposal: Fundo padrão comum e convenções do protocolo; piloto limitado já concluído.
clauses.application_condition: Cinco pontos não cobrem prior; zlei distinto zstar e rstar distinto rdrag.
clauses.implementation_gap: Escolher motor direto qualificado ou tabela ampliada, cobertura/erro/custo sem zero por ausência.

clauses.title: Projeção e normalização
clauses.proposal: Unidades transportadas em todas as colunas/C; suporte/pdet/quotiente preservados.
clauses.application_condition: PSD comum e restrição do núcleo; não jitter para forçar passagem; cota148 condicional72 vínculos.
clauses.implementation_gap: Verificação da aplicação completa por cenário ainda necessária.

clauses.title: Cinco testes e decisão V2
clauses.proposal: Calibração por teste/cenário; rejeição válida não suprimida; H1 não rejeitado requer ambos H1 válidos.
clauses.application_condition: Máximo só sobre família completa; rivals separados; poder posterior e independente.
clauses.implementation_gap: Implementar saída única e estados conforme V2; nenhum valor observado aqui.

clauses.title: Cota conservadora
clauses.proposal: G residual; Q/T span global17/18 como recomendação, residual para todos como alternativa.
clauses.application_condition: Gaussianidade/C fixa comuns, domínio verdadeiro incluído e span global, não tangente; prova condicional.
clauses.implementation_gap: Certificar aplicação, L/U mínimos e SF superior com erros; oito controles em unidade separada.

clauses.title: Bayes e informação
clauses.proposal: Bayes relativo separado; logJ/10lnB por cenário e erros; informação/poder separado.
clauses.application_condition: Nenhuma conversão lnB/sqrtDeltaChi2 em sigma; sem média de cenários sem pesos.
clauses.implementation_gap: Integral/caudas/erros/custo ainda a protocolar; sem poder global calculado.

clauses.title: Cronologia e reprodução
clauses.proposal: Proveniência e E45 preservadas como história documental, com P4/P5 separados.
clauses.application_condition: Use-novelty sem veto temporal; não confundir data interna com publicação certificada; não novo resultado.
clauses.implementation_gap: Conservar rastreio de uso/seleção antes do V1; não rerodar arquivos históricos.

clauses.title: V1 final e abertura
clauses.proposal: Este é rascunho revisável de F1, não F1 concluída/V1 congelado.
clauses.application_condition: Abertura depende da decisão sobre o V1 por hash prevista na ordem; esta entrega não a concede.
clauses.implementation_gap: Ratificação e integração/certificados concretos, seguidos de decisão de abertura; sem repetir controles consumidos.

H4_Cepheid.response: c_C delta_C in elementary network; not uniform total-H0 shift

definitions.ellhat: sup of full normalized sampling log likelihood over each model physical domain and shared eta; not log of flat-marginal integral
definitions.G_domain: Gaussian common fixed C_s and common affine support, ranks/units qualified; extension to parameter-dependent estimated errors requires separate generative contract

physical_priors.theta: independent normalized uniforms H0[50,90],wb[.015,.03],wc[.08,.18]; density50/3 in these coordinates
physical_priors.H4_s: Uniform[-.15,.15], density10/3; pi_delta=ln(10)/1.5*10^(-delta/5) on transformed interval
physical_priors.H5_rd: Uniform[130,160] Mpc, density1/30; pi_q_given_theta=rd_CAMB(theta)/30, variable endpoints
physical_priors.flat_eta: kappa d eta common to all models; relative ratios only, not absolute evidence or a sampling prior

data.background: Planck compressed3 (Chen2019 covariance convention) + DESI DR2 full13
data.row_order: upstream loop order; stable source row IDs identify all raw rows; intercept rows are named derived rows
data.block_factorization: INPUT conditional sampling model, no empirical proof of missing cross-covariance=0
data.other_routes: Planck-only, sirens, lenses and CC not part of this primary proposed joint contract

nuisance.recommendation: same kappa d eta in R63; finite nonzero relative integrals only

definitions.P: C+ - C+ X F^-1 X.T C+

required: full X column rank inside C support
formula.computable_prefactors_cancel_only_when: same X,C,r independent of all integrated parameters; otherwise keep inside each integral
formula.kappa_cancellation: single constant common to all models; different eta dimensions or unidentified flat directions invalidate automatic cancellation

units.convention: multiply local log10 rows by5 together with X,a_h,c_C and covariance congruence; preserve fixed offsets and exact row identity from source

systematics.interpretation: restricted finite conditional sensitivity family, not measured distribution of truth
systematics.dedup_rule: full covariance + response + likelihood normalization hashes, preserving original label map; no presumed count of full distinct matrices
systematics.boundary_singular_cases: excluded from this interior family and separate contract
systematics.policy: every case, no data-selected best case; p_robust=max_s p_s, Bayes intervals=min/max_s log-ratios
systematics.incomplete_family: explicit SYSTEMATICS_COVERAGE_LIMITED always; cannot certify all physical systematics

MM.conditional_published_error_model: Admissible proposal with explicit conditional Gaussian sampling assumptions and declared scope; not unconditional coverage proof for original distance estimator.
MM.plugin_or_data_dependent_covariance: No automatic exact finite-sample calibration; separate model/propagation and calibration needed.
MM.required_decision: Choose explicit sampling interpretation and propagation before complete covariance/application certification.

redshift_conventions.law_redshift_status: historical INPUT, held fixed; not substituted by derived recombination redshift

claims.question: absolute fit of complete route/model/data contract
fixed beta law against its free-beta extension; nonnegative only if nested fits qualified

primary_family.scope: within this fixed preregistered family; not experiment-wide all historical searches
primary_family.secondary_routes: Planck-only, other maps/data reuse remain descriptive until included in a separately frozen larger family; no independent combination

definition_of_calibrated_tail.p_per_s: sup_(xi in null domain, eta if invariance not proved) Pr_null,xi,s[T_j(Y*) >= T_j(Yobs)]
definition_of_calibrated_tail.continuous_nuisance: finite grid maximum is not certified supremum; validated bounding or stated conditional qualification required
definition_of_calibrated_tail.eta_reduction: only after proving invariance to Y_local -> Y_local+Xv of the full estimator/statistic/support procedure; then simulate eta=0 representative, not improper flat prior sampling
definition_of_calibrated_tail.systematic_null_union: p_robust_j=max_s p_j,s; valid for union of the explicitly admitted scenarios if every p_j,s is valid for its null
definition_of_calibrated_tail.multiplicity: p_FWER_j=min(1,5*p_robust_j); Bonferroni, arbitrary dependence; same5used for all claims
definition_of_calibrated_tail.sigma_convention: Z_eq=Phi^-1(1-p_FWER) upper-tail Gaussian equivalent only, no measured Gaussian residual assumption
definition_of_calibrated_tail.two_sided_warning: not the two-sided |z| tail; do not call sqrtDeltaChi2 a calibrated sigma
definition_of_calibrated_tail.monte_carlo: at fixed simple null, exchangeable independent full-pipeline replicates: (1+exceedances)/(N+1); no zero p; finite runs do not qualify composite nuisance supremum
definition_of_calibrated_tail.tail_budget: standard Monte Carlo may need at least ceil(5/alpha5)-1 draws merely to resolve the Bonferroni5sigma threshold at zero exceedances; no such run authorized here. Rare-event alternatives require independently verified bounds/weights.
definition_of_calibrated_tail.numerical_and_MC_error: use conservative upper bounds; if confidence bounds used as guarantees, allocate total certification failure probability within overall alpha budget, not an arbitrary 1% beside5sigma
definition_of_calibrated_tail.unqualified_tail_output: CALIBRATION_UNAVAILABLE plus raw statistics if valid; no numeric sigma claim

decision.shape: separate fields, never single early-return underpowered gate
priority_rules: If unopened/missing input/ratification: AWAITING_DATA_OR_RATIFICATION, all observed fields null, keep contract/preflight.
If invalid common support/integrity/numerics: explicit failure with safe raw diagnostics; do not label physical rejection from a failed instrument.

If calibration unavailable or partial for a test: retain its valid raw G/Q/T and lnB separately, report missing scenarios; do not emit its robust p/sigma, non-rejection or positive combined discrimination.
Evaluate calibrated residual/rejection and every scenario BEFORE considering power.

If either complete calibrated H1 test rejects robustly after Bonferroni5: report ROUTE_H1_REJECTED_AT_5SIGMA_CONDITIONAL_CONTRACT even if the other is unavailable; retain missing state and low-power/systematic limits.
If only some scenarios reject/prefer: SYSTEMATICS_SENSITIVE_RESULT, report all, no robust claim.

Combined discrimination from Hj requires H1_calibrated_not_rejected, complete calibrated Hj_TO_H1, certified T_j1>0 in every admitted scenario and adjusted p<=alpha5; j=2,4,5 separately. Not evidence of rejecting the containing H3 class.

NOT_FALSIFIED_IN_THIS_CONTRACT requires both H1 tests complete, calibrated and non-rejected; absent calibration is never no rejection. Power is a separate field and missing rival comparisons remain visible.
If systematic family incomplete: SYSTEMATICS_COVERAGE_LIMITED stays visible even when conditional significance extreme.

calibration_per_test_per_scenario.rule: No unavailable or invalid value is replaced by zero, non-rejection or a numeric sigma. Raw valid statistics and relative Bayes outputs remain separately visible.

decision_predicates.complete_test_j: For every frozen admitted scenario exactly once, a valid statistic and valid uniformly conservative null p upper bound including numerical uncertainty are available; no omitted scenarios. Certified equivalent scenario coverage may substitute only with a frozen proof and full label mapping.
decision_predicates.p_robust_j: Defined only if complete_test_j; maximum over every admitted scenario p upper bound, not a maximum over the available subset.
decision_predicates.H1_rejected: reject_COMPAT_H1 OR reject_LAW_H1_VS_FREE; either valid complete rejection remains reportable if the other test is unavailable, with that missing state visible.
decision_predicates.H1_calibrated_not_rejected: complete_test_COMPAT_H1 AND complete_test_LAW_H1_VS_FREE AND NOT reject_COMPAT_H1 AND NOT reject_LAW_H1_VS_FREE. This means only not rejected by the adopted tests, not model validation.
decision_predicates.combined_discrimination_H1_from_Hj: H1_calibrated_not_rejected AND complete_test_Hj_TO_H1 AND all admitted scenarios have certified positive T_j1 AND reject_Hj_TO_H1; j=2,4,5 separately.
decision_predicates.NOT_FALSIFIED_IN_THIS_CONTRACT: Allowed only when H1_calibrated_not_rejected. Missing rival comparisons remain explicitly unavailable; they are not required to report the two valid non-rejections of H1.
decision_predicates.CALIBRATION_UNAVAILABLE_OR_PARTIAL: If any claimed test lacks complete_test_j, its robust decision is unavailable; retain its valid raw per-scenario values and identify missing/invalid scenarios. Do not suppress any other valid rejection or evidence output.
decision_predicates.power: Independent final field; never turns missing calibration into non-rejection, nor suppresses a calibrated rejection.

recommended_calibration.classification: DERIVED conditional finite-sample stochastic upper envelopes; not exact tail laws

prerequisites.requirement: Fixed known Gaussian joint covariance per frozen scenario, common to all compared models
Same affine support, observation units and density normalizations
True mean and nuisance contained in declared null domains
Fixed X of supported full column rank63, eta in R^63
All actual model means globally contained in declared response span for refined bound
Whitening, quotient and global span recomputed or certified for each scenario
Exact inherited72 covariance constraints if residual df upper148 is used
Certified lower bounds for true global minima, feasible certified upper bounds for competitors
Certified upper numerical SF including theory/rounding errors; no numerical zero tail
Entire frozen scenario family available or proved equivalent coverage, with label mapping
Selection and multiplicity contract held fixed, no new data-dependent route selection
Conditional interpretation of reported or plug-in errors explicitly ratified

base_theorem.uniformity: all admitted true physical parameters and eta; no improper sampling prior

gain_theorem.inclusion: Every R_s[mu_comp(xi)-mu_null(xi0)] belongs to fixed V_s for every pair of allowed parameters
gain_theorem.B17_columns: 16 background coordinate columns plus extended local a_h
gain_theorem.V_s: Range(R_s B17) or Range(R_s B18), with scenario-specific R_s

structural_dimensions.degree_148_guard: Exact72 covariance kernel constraints and supported rank63 X in actual joint matrix

subset_262.scope: Historical conditional engineering subset, not full experiment

test_envelopes.statistic_lower: max(0,L1-U3), only with qualified H1 subset H3

certificates.minima: For every required model, deterministic L_i<=global_inf_RSS_i<=U_i
certificates.local_optimizer_returns: feasible upper U only; never global lower L
certificates.global_lower_option: minimum distance to certified outer enclosures over complete null-domain cell cover
certificates.theory: include entire-domain prediction/support/whitening/roundoff errors, not five-point agreement only
certificates.tail: upper numerical SF, stable at small p; exact/interval error bounds
certificates.probabilistic_certification: Any failure probability must be allocated inside total alpha budget

p_value.zero_dimension: point mass0 with inclusive tail, no generic chi2(df=0)
p_value.robust: max_s p_upper over complete frozen family or certified equivalent coverage
p_value.Z_equivalent_lower: Phi^-1(1-p_familywise_upper), optional, not positive evidence for large p

V2_interoperation.weak_bound: Valid but non-rejecting conservative test, not missing calibration
V2_interoperation.weak_bound_limit: Does not show exact p exceeds alpha; does not validate the model
V2_interoperation.not_falsified: Only both complete valid H1 tests non-reject under V2; power separate
V2_interoperation.incomplete: No robust p/non-rejection from subset of available scenarios
V2_interoperation.bayes: All relative evidence remains separately computed under its own measure contract

frequentist.eight_synthetic_controls: Separate unit; not executed or consumed as a new result in this draft.

bayesian_relative.measure: flat eta integrated with existing qualified formula; proper physical/model-specific priors
bayesian_relative.J_i_s: integral L_bg_i * L_local_flat_i * pi_i over physical parameters
bayesian_relative.output: all five log J_i up to same arbitrary constant; ten pairwise ln B_ij=ln J_i-ln J_j per scenario, numerical uncertainty, ranges
bayesian_relative.requirements: finite nonzero integrals, common support/eta/units/Jacobians, full prior coverage; no table-missing=zero
bayesian_relative.weights: no summing/multiplying/minimizing scenarios or routes; mixture would need prior weights fixed first
bayesian_relative.legacy_thresholds: optional separate reporting flags min_s lnB12>=5 and min_s lnB13>=-1; not sigma or substitute for compatibility; H1 lies within H3 so cannot reject whole H3 in favor of contained H1

chronology_and_reproduction.E45: Historical reproduction, not a new F9 result; P4 scalar SH0ES and P5 Pantheon_SH0ES shadow kept distinct; no combined independent evidence.
chronology_and_reproduction.use_novelty: Retrodição sem ajuste is admissible; provenance and selection/multiplicity remain explicit; no temporal novelty veto.
